bio: George Wright was a Black Liberation Army member who on July 31, 1972 hijacked Delta Air Lines Flight 841 from Detroit, seeking passage to Algeria to join the exiled Black Panther International Section. He later relocated to France, Guinea-Bissau and then Portugal where he acquired Portuguese citizenship and started a family. Portuguese police arrested him in September 2011, after fingerprints connected his Portuguese identity to his fugitive record. Portuguese courts refused the American extradition request and he was released.
